info.name: eSuite Webhook API (DEV/PROD)
info.description: Auto-signing collection for esuite-webhook-service. Set env vars base_url, client_id, client_secret. Pre-request script signs every request (HMAC-SHA256 of exact body). Generated from webhook-api-audit.

exec: // Compute eSuite webhook auth values -> collection variables.
// Headers are declared explicitly on each request as {{authorization}}/{{x_signature}}/
// {{x_timestamp}}/{{x_request_id}}, so they appear in the Headers tab & generated cURL.
// This script refreshes those variables (fresh timestamp + signature) on every Send.
// resolve any {{vars}} ONCE so the signed bytes match what Postman sends.
pm.request.body.raw = body; // pin so send-time resolution is identical
